comment: 52yo male, 22 years residential + commercial chimney sweep (creosote + soot exposure, pre-modern PPE practices in early career), current smoker 15 pack-years. No current cutaneous SCC, scrotal SCC, or lung cancer. Historical anchor cohort — Pott 1775 chimney-sweep scrotal-cancer observation is foundational occupational-carcinogenesis evidence. Engine routes to PreventionPlan: standard = annual dermatology full-skin exam (focus on soot-contact areas including scrotum) + risk-adjusted annual LDCT chest (soot-modified USPSTF criteria) + smoking-cessation counseling (paramount for lung component) + monthly self-skin-checks + sun-protection + PPE + soot-saturated-clothing-avoidance counseling; alternative = symptom-triggered evaluation + cessation counseling only. Validates v0.3 occupational batch-3 pilot — fires RF-OCC-SOOT-PREVENTION.
